result:
US March AP and expense review is complete. Summary of what I found and did:

**Fixed (with support attached):**
1. **Duplicate vendor bill — $31,148.20.** Stackline Cloud invoice STA-98877 was booked twice (JE-00232 and JE-00241) off the same document, with only one payment clearing the bank. Reversed JE-00241 via **JE-00307** and, since it exceeds the $10k posting limit, **requested controller approval** (pending).
2. **Miscoding — $3,880.00.** Northgate Data Centers NDC-7719 is a *colocation* invoice but was posted to Meals & Entertainment as a "team dinner." Reclassed to Hosting & Infrastructure via **JE-00308**. March M&E now $49.75, in line with prior months.
3. **Unrecorded bank fee — $65.00.** The 3/31 monthly service charge had no ledger entry. Posted **JE-00309** and matched it to BT-US-0085.

**Escalated (EXC-001):**
4. **"Legal retainer" $6,750 (JE-00288)** — posted manually with *no* supporting document; the bank line reads only "WIRE OUT ACCT ENDING 7731" with no payee, and nothing in the document store corroborates it. I did not reverse it (cash genuinely left) and did not force support. Needs payee identification and a classification decision — if it's a true retainer it belongs in Prepaid Expenses, not Legal Fees.

**Reviewed, no adjustment:** the two identical $149.90 Zoom charges on 3/08 look like a duplicate but both hit the bank with separate receipts, so the books are right — I recommended a vendor dispute instead of a journal entry. AP cutoff tested clean (all March bills recorded, no unbilled March services found) and that checklist item is marked complete. I also noted the stale $96,300 migrated AP balance for follow-up.
